risks: can read as a generic 3D render
reflection detail may turn to noise

tension.description: The viewer looks for a self in the metal and finds only the environment.

concepts.thesis: A perfectly reflective form returns the whole industrial room to the viewer but withholds the face: identity appears only as the distortion it causes in a surface.
concepts.title: The Mirror That Refuses
concepts.visual_hypothesis: A single liquid-chrome sculptural mass, implied human contour, hard key light; the reflection carries more information than the object.

risks: grain may alias at small sizes

tension.description: Marks of touch are indistinguishable from marks of manufacture.

concepts.thesis: Brushed steel keeps the direction of every abrasion; identity is the accumulated record of contact rather than a likeness.
concepts.title: Brushed Memory
concepts.visual_hypothesis: A torso-scaled brushed-steel plane with directional grain and one polished seam.

tension.description: The figure is legible only while the metal holds; the image is the moment before collapse.

concepts.thesis: Identity as surface tension: a body-shaped chrome volume caught between solid and liquid.
concepts.title: Molten Self
concepts.visual_hypothesis: Fluid chrome with drips and a stable shoulder line, cool light, black ground.

distinctness_rationale: Concepts differ in material state (mirror, brushed, molten) and in where identity is located (reflection, abrasion, surface tension).
